[{"insert":"Hinge, Back, Bicep

This is a three move circuit that hinges, pulls, and curls with short rests to keep your heart rate up. Start light with the weight. The 15 second rests between moves are there on purpose so each set stays crisp. Treat it as an extension of your Strength Balance work with a higher heart rate, not an all out sprint.
"}]
